customerOutcome: Test the reviewed unpublished native draft without publishing it, reconcile its original admission and inspect actual execution separately from production validity.
entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and company selection; no retained foreign-principal payload
Effective feature admission is required for new work; native membership and resource authority remain necessary
exitConditions: Only a canonical server-confirmed result permits a success claim
Pending, stale, unavailable or unqualified work never becomes successful or activated

content.supportingCopy: Review the draft version, empty synthetic input, expected Succeeded result and configured stop deadline before admission. Only internal control steps are qualified here.
displayedState: Current native draft ID, version, workflow updatedAt and internal eligibility are distinct from the published version.
Only the closed manual/condition/switch/merge/parallel C0 subset with empty input, no contracts/variables and a 1–60 second deadline is admitted.

Native publish topology must pass before the view reports internal Test readiness; incomplete condition paths, disconnected nodes and cycles remain review-required. Full native node validation repeats at admission.
The confirmation freezes the reviewed draft version and expected outcome; changing the native draft does not change an open confirmation.
The original receipt means admitted, not completed or production verified. Follow its exact run for actual status and recorded steps.
The latest original admission is recovered for the current human from native activity; an unrelated older admission cannot acknowledge an in-memory unknown attempt.
Test purpose remains explicit after draft replacement, publication and retirement. Optimizer production traces, correction reviews, samples and live drift exclude tests.

inputs.label: I understand this is an internal test with no production input.
inputs.help: No publication, agent/model/tool/network calls or material effects are admitted by this test.
inputs.validation: Explicitly checked before sending the reviewed command.
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: Never infer acknowledgement from an earlier test.

primary.label: Start internal test
primary.operation: Admit the exact reviewed draft through the native workflow queue with source=test and an atomic original-request activity receipt.

secondary: Reload and recover the native original receipt
Inspect the exact bound test run
Open Advanced to review unsupported/material testing; no implicit publication is performed

canonicalReadDomains: Current native workflow/draft/source authority, exact company/principal and effective read/edit/run grants
Native workflow.customer_test_admitted activity, actual run/revision bindings and retained-source admission
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: admitCustomerWorkflowTest uses the existing native authority/privacy/settings and workflow locks, enqueueWorkflowRunInTransaction and native activity receipt. The existing executor/leases/recovery/cancellation execute the unpublished immutable revision; no second scheduler or run store.
systemWork.authorityEffect: Current human read/edit/run and actual non-viewer membership/current admin role are required for new admission and original replay. Recovery rechecks the original initiating human. This grants no access and publishes nothing.
systemWork.asyncWork: Native closed C0 execution with configured deadline up to 60 seconds. Source review has a 30-second admission budget. Admission is durable even if inline execution or its HTTP response fails.
systemWork.receipt: Strict company/workflow/request/revision/run binding plus purpose=test and disposition=admitted. Native queue and activity commit together; original replay creates neither a second run nor another original event.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: No current draft or inactive workflow permits new test admission; an existing original receipt remains historical.
states.partial: Oversized, duplicate, cyclic or dangling-connection flows show flow unavailable with no truncated topology.
states.stale: Hide retained private data during background rechecks and live authority/privacy/version invalidations; a new query epoch rejects late prior responses.
states.validation_error: Changed native review requires a fresh confirmation. Unsupported graphs require separately qualified testing.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Retain the identical unknown command in memory; a reload reads the current human's actual native receipt. Absence of a receipt does not prove that a timed-out request cannot still commit.
states.success: Only native admission is confirmed here. The separately read run status is actual execution status, not production/business validity.

navigation.back: Return to existing native workflow list.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Closing an in-memory dialog retains its exact Original command for existing explicit idempotent retry. Route reload retains only a content-free locator; exact GET recovery reads the Original journal. A Native pre-effect refusal can release only its own tuple.
navigation.resume: Current Native read and a bounded content-free per-tab company/account/workflow/kind/request locator survive page return. Follow the exact Original request GET under current account/permission/Source admission; no new command identity is inferred from absence.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Current human/company-authorized workflow name and description
Bound original native test receipt and explicit test purpose only; no test payload or private errors.
dataCollected: Strict immutable command UUID and reviewed native version preconditions; no customer input or browser persistence.
sensitiveFields: Native graph configuration, prompts, credentials, inputs, schemas, variables, actor assignments and results are excluded from this projection
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Purpose-separated workflow-experience namespace for success and rejected requests; generic logs omit account query strings, workflow/customer prose and raw errors.

functional: Verify actual unpublished execution without publication/cloning/live admission; simultaneous original requests, draft replacement/publication, Pause, rollback and private receipt recovery.
Verify expected result/deadline and explicit acknowledgement; retained unknown commands and matching native receipts; strict purpose separation and optimizer exclusions.
Representative/material/customer-approved inputs, simulated writes/test targets, material side-effect disclosure, independent business verification and full workflow Test scope remain open.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify actual read/edit/run grant loss and current role/admin/membership/source revocation on admission, replay, receipt reads and queued recovery; denied/late views never restore private data.
Verify other humans cannot recover this original receipt; corrupted native bindings and public manual-source injection are rejected.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
